title: Arkret Agent Selector Claim
description: Signed claim binding a controller-scoped Agent selector slug to one exact Agent AccountId. It powers @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug> compose-time resolution without making the agent carry a public handle. The selector namespace is principal-scoped and the resolved target is account-scoped; the two are different responsibilities and neither is derived from the other.

controller_subject_id.description: Controller principal DID that owns the selector namespace.

agent_slug.description: Controller-scoped slug used as the right-hand side of @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug>.

subject_account_id.description: Exact Agent AccountId this selector resolves to, principal and Station component both. The namespace stays principal-scoped -- (controller_subject_id, agent_slug) -- but the target the controller signs is one account: a valid controller signature does not authorise pointing the slug at an arbitrary account that happens to share the agent principal. A consumer copies this value verbatim into the mention node; it MUST NOT rebuild it from a bare principal, the controller handle's Station, a DID default Station or the resolving facade.

issuer_id.description: DID that signs this selector claim. It is normally controller_subject; a delegated issuer MUST be authorized by controller_subject and bound in source_refs or proof evidence.

vouching_id.description: Optional service-only vouching role that served or vouched for this selector claim when distinct from issuer_id. The service subject-class requirement is validated independently of the field name.

visibility.description: Disclosure boundary for selector resolution. Restricted/private claims require audience and requester policy checks before returning subject.

audience.description: Audience binding for restricted selector disclosure, such as a Realm ID, verifier domain, or service DID.

claim_scope.description: Optional scope such as realm_id, organization_id, purpose, allowed_operations, or disclosure policy tags.

source_refs.description: Optional refs to accountability_grant, actor profile, provisioning, delegation, or revocation evidence.
